data.application-admin.yml:
server:
  forward-headers-strategy: framework
  servlet:
    session:
      cookie:
        name: ALISA_ADMIN_SESSION
        path: /admin/auth
        secure: true
        http-only: true
        same-site: lax
spring:
  application:
    name: alisa-admin-api
  cloud:
    discovery:
      enabled: false
    nacos:
      discovery:
        enabled: false
        register-enabled: false
      config:
        enabled: false
alisa:
  tenancy:
    enabled: true
  authorization:
    enabled: true
    administrators:
      - ${PORTAL_BOOTSTRAP_ADMINISTRATOR}
    applications:
      portal: tenant
  oauth:
    enabled: true
    issuer: https://alisa.vip.cpolar.cn/admin/auth
    applications:
      portal:
        "[portal:console:manage]": 管理门户资源
